_meta.notes: Sōtō Zen reached Peru with Japanese immigration; Taiheizan Jionji (1907) is the oldest Zen temple in Latin America. The Comunidad Budista Sōtō Zenshū del Perú is the Sōtōshū-affiliated body.

places.name: Templo Ryūzan Zuihōji
places.lineage: Sōtō (Comunidad Budista Sōtō Zenshū del Perú)
places.address: Julián Arias Aragüez 652, Miraflores, Lima 18, Peru
places.notes: Founded 2005 in Miraflores; the urban temple of the Comunidad Budista Sōtō Zenshū del Perú and its main zazen venue.

places.name: Templo Taiheizan Jionji
places.notes: Founded 1907, ~140km south of Lima — the oldest Zen temple in Latin America, established by the Japanese immigrant community. Hosts intensive zazen and baika chanting.

places.name: Espacio de Práctica Zen Cusco
places.lineage: Sōtō (Comunidad Budista Sōtō Zenshū del Perú)
places.notes: Practice space opened 2012; the Andean branch of the Peruvian Sōtō community.
